Round 31 froze three claims: C1 (depth — chat-completions parameter outcomes on pinned llama-server b11755; frozen counter .ufo/waves/round-31/count-c1.py, predicate 'counted >= 12'), C2 (calibration — revision-keyed evidence on every SCORECARD claim row; frozen counter .ufo/waves/round-31/count-c2.py), C3 (operability — instrument-registry coverage via tools/gate-registry-check.py).
